say:2:1510237002:0.text: At the sacred hour of the Blood Moon, the Herdmaster descended, wielding divine power to scatter the Halians. Now they kneel in chains before us!

say:3:1510237003:0.text: The days of suffering under the wickedness of humans end now! Let justice be served! Blood shall answer for blood!

say:18:1510237011:0.text: Kordan, it seems that the Herdmaster has other plans for the Halians.
say:18:1510237011:0.source_cn: 戈丹……看来兽群之主对呼临人另有打算，我们不能妄加揣测。

say:19:1510237012:0.text: Then, they shall not be killed yet.

say:21:1510237014:0.text: Next, let's have a welcoming ceremony.

say:22:1510237015:0.text: Come, children of the Wildborn. Lift your voices in sacred song, dance, and offer up our succulent bounty.
say:22:1510237015:0.source_cn: 来，雅库伯尔的儿女，向神明献上热忱的歌舞和鲜美的食物。

say:23:1510237016:0.source_cn: 狩猎神，享用雅库伯尔给你的供奉吧！

choice:17:1:2.text: I have more questions for them.
